name: kennel
description: Run Claude Code and Codex agents as remote, queueable sessions.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b --pretty false && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.typecheck.json --pretty false && tsc -p packages/mcp/tsconfig.typecheck.json --pretty false && tsc -p packages/server/tsconfig.typecheck.json --pretty false
scripts.test: npm run build && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --import tsx --test --test-force-exit packages/core/test/*.test.ts packages/mcp/test/*.test.ts packages/server/test/*.test.ts
